name: Community — MiniMax H3-Image (open weights)
author: michaeldune
description:
Model format: int8 ConvRot. Steps: 6 by default.

MiniMax's open-weight H3-Image model: text to image at 4 or 16 megapixels and editing with up to four pictures, through a built-in prompt writer. Runs on a 12 GB card. Reuses the H3 text encoder the H3 video packs already download, plus about 29 GB of its own files. Needs SimpliGen's engine at ComfyUI v0.45.0 or newer.

presets.name: MiniMax H3-Image
presets.description:
Text to image with MiniMax H3-Image, the open-weight image model MiniMax released in November 2026. A built-in prompt writer turns your request into a full description first, so a short line is enough, and it is good at exact lettering on signs, covers and posters. Renders at about 4 megapixels (2368x1760 at 4:3). The built-in prompt writer refuses sexual requests: nudity works, sex acts do not.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed.

requirements.notes: Weights from Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image (commit 0bb149f): the 33B H3-Image transformer, pruned int8 (21.0 GB), its single-frame VAE (1.2 GB) and the Qwen3.5 9B w4a8 prompt expander (7.3 GB); the 32B nvfp4 text encoder (15.7 GB) is the one the H3 video packs already use. Needs ComfyUI v0.45.0 (Comfy-Org/ComfyUI#17655). Graph per the Comfy template: 6 steps, cfg 1, euler/simple, zeroed negative. Every request first goes through the expander, which writes the detailed caption the model renders; without it the model misses parts of the request. The expander samples (template settings) and thinks first, which adds about 25-65 s per new prompt. User LoRA slot (rgthree Power Lora Loader, as on P-H3-Image): H3 video LoRAs load, because H3-Image is the same transformer without the audio stream. Tested 2026-11-11 with kreaillustrator_style, h3-realism-people and cinemagrade_style: every key mapped, an empty slot gives the identical picture, and a warm 4 MP run with a LoRA took 53 s in SimpliGen. Trigger words go to the expander with the request, and it may leave them out of its caption; the style LoRAs tested still applied without them.

presets.name: MiniMax H3-Image 16 MP
presets.tagline: MiniMax's open H3-Image model at its best size, 16 megapixels
presets.description:
The same model at 16 megapixels (4736x3552 at 4:3), the size MiniMax says gives the best results. Slower than the 4 MP card, and very large files. The built-in prompt writer refuses sexual requests: nudity works, sex acts do not.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

presets.name: MiniMax H3-Image Edit
presets.tagline: Edit a picture by describing the change
presets.description:
Edit a picture with MiniMax H3-Image. Picture 1 is the one that changes; the result keeps its shape at about 4 megapixels. Pictures 2 to 4 are optional; name them in the request as <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, for example: Put the hat from <Picture 2> on the man in <Picture 1>. The built-in prompt writer refuses sexual requests: nudity works, sex acts do not.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.
